'''Crix Sunburris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and an [[Jedi ace|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within the ranks of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]]. Stationed at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the years proceeding the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], Sunburris contributed much to the Order, credited with beginning the ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' project. Additionally, Sunburris penned several chapters of the Temple guidebook titled, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.

==Biography==
Like most Jedi of the era, Master Sunburris served the Order as a member of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] in the crusades against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] known as the [[New Sith Wars]]. A member of the [[Jedi Starfighter Corps]] for over two decades, Master Sunburris was dubbed a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Warrior Master]] and [[Air Marshal of the Republic]] following his accomplishments in the war; such as destroying over 300 enemy starfighters. Upgrading the Order's fleet of vessels post-war, Master Sunburris began traveling the galaxy and visiting the satellite [[Jedi academy|academies]] operated by the Order.<ref name="TJP" />

Always in top shape, Sunburris would spend several hours each day engaged in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Cadence/Legends|cadences]], unarmed combat, and sprinting. Because of his station in the Starfighter Corps, the leaders of the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] would often consult with Sunburris in regards to their [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ships]]. Post war, Sunburris sponsored a project that was designed to produce a massive ship (which he attempted to name after himself) for use in galactic travel and exploration. Together with Masters [[Fin-So-Rowan/Legends|Fin-So-Rowan]] and [[Ivixa Delbaeth]], Sunburris and his forward-thinking colleagues hoped to give Jedi Knights and Padawans alike more exposure to galactic cultures than was available at the Jedi Temple. The project was not finished during his lifetime, but eventually saw fruition under the name, the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''. When his fellow Masters proposed that a guidebook to the life of the Jedi be written, Master Sunburris agreed to work on the project, contributing several chapters regarding to the work of the Guardians, galactic travel, and education aboard praxeum ships.<ref name="TJP" />

==Personality and traits==
Sunburris was unquestionably an excellent starfighter pilot and lightsaber duellist. However, he was something of a braggart, and did not hesitate to promote his personal achievements. In his chapters in ''The Jedi Path'', he was quick to name his various titles and his deed of destroying over 300 starfighters during the [[New Sith Wars]]. When consulted for a project to create a massive new [[Praxeum ship/Legends|praxeum ship]], Sunburris initially attempted to name the vessel after himself.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
While it did not make it into the finished edition, [[Daniel Wallace]], author of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], released a list detailing the genders and species of each of the authors of the in-universe ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Master Sunburris is revealed to be a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Daniel Wallace viewed Sunburris' character as that of a braggart.<ref name="JCF" />
